text.p: Following are the main stories in Friday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- Most newspapers lead with National Front coalition sweeping all three state by-elections, clearing the way for Selangor state chief minister designate Abu Hassan to be confirmed in his appointment.
-- Malaysia has reached a level of development where it can offer volunteer services to needy nations, acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said.
-- Malaysia Airlines posted a 349.41 million ringgit group pretax profit for the year ended March 31, 1997, its best financial performance ever.

-- Malaysian Airlines System Bhd has achieved its highest ever group pretax profit of 349.41 million ringgit for the financial year ended March 31 1997, up 39.1 percent from 251.16 million for the previous year.
-- Johor Corp, already a highly-diversified group, will be venturing into the stockbroking industry, at home and abroad.
